body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics will unveil 'IceTouch', its new mp3 player equipped with a 2-inch transparent AMOLED screen at the upcoming CES 2010 held in Las Vegas. The IceTouch adopts the company's new UI called 'TouchWiz Sweep' which allows users to browse the menu with a tapping and swiping motion of the finger. With the company's exclusive sound technology better than DNSe, it also brings enhanced video playback, supporting a variety of video file formats such as DivX, MPEG4, XviD, H.264 and more.
